question: Describe a time you had to manage a team through a significant change or restructuring.
intendedUser: Operations and management professional with 1-3 years of experience
description: Behavioural question assessing change management and team leadership skills.
purposeOfQuestion: The interviewer evaluates the candidate's ability to lead teams through uncertainty, maintain productivity, and communicate transparently during restructuring.
exampleAnswer: When my department was restructured at my company, I Context: reporting lines and responsibilities changed completely. I: held individual meetings with each team member to understand concerns, created a 30-day transition plan with clear milestones, and maintained open communication channels. Result: team productivity maintained at 95% during transition, and three team members were promoted within 6 months due to expanded responsibilities.
evaluationCriteria: Communication transparency during change, structured transition planning, team morale maintenance, evidence of team development
